_comments: Sets JSONType metadata on the CodeVersion, OutputSemantics and Delivery columns of MJ: ML Models so CodeGen emits
typed CodeVersionObject / OutputSemanticsObject / DeliveryObject accessors on MJMLModelEntity returning
Every type in the shared JSONType-interfaces/IMLModelJsonTypes.ts mirrors its @memberjunction/predictive-studio-core type field for field (PR 4 Task M1.5).
The EntityField rows must exist (created by a CodeGen pass over the new columns) before these @lookups resolve on push.
All fields bind the one combined file, so CodeGen emits its declarations once (CollectJSONTypeBlock dedupes by text).
CodeVersion field — the code a run executed (repository commit, sidecar and library versions, threads, seed)
OutputSemantics field — the model's declared task type (scored class and adverse direction are derived)
Delivery field — the registry's view of the gate's delivery: the stored file with the gate decision inside
